gates.scope: Only the specified source file and new crate integration tests may change; upstream inline tests must remain byte-identical. No new unsafe blocks or suppressed checks.
gates.tests: cargo +1.93.1 test --offline --locked --workspace; all 15 original tests and at least one newly added integration test execute successfully
gates.oracle: External consumer tests supplied only after the agent finishes must compile and pass
gates.regression_sensitivity: The new agent-authored integration tests must fail against the unmodified source because the requested API is absent or the requested behavior is not implemented; environment failures do not count.

pass_rule: All automated gates pass and task-specific manual criteria pass. Do not repair generated patches before grading.

R1: Both public annotation entry points share one implementation.
No whole-envelope clone is used to implement the in-place entry point.
R2: First occurrence is retained without rewriting accepted names or mutating inputs.
Existing public API and IR derivation remain intact.
R3: Serialization reuses the existing registry builder, without a duplicate registry table.
Writer errors retain serde_json::Error and no explicit flush is introduced.

limitations: No numerical score for verbosity or incidental style.
Manual source review is by the primary agent, not blinded.
One fresh session per case/condition; no repeated runs or exposed backend model identity.
